I'm assuming that Sky's promos will keep the "Tiny, Normal, Huge" keywords and just utilize different base powers, but that tells more about how boring I am than how the actual design would play out.

Also, Silverleaf, from what I understand the "Tall, Grande, Venti" sizing is meant to make customers feel like they're part of an elite few with their own unique coffee jargon. It's a strategy that makes you feel like an "in-group" coffee afficionado rather than just rebranding cup sizes used at any fast food joint around the States. People can get very sensitive and abrasive if you lightly correct their "grande mocha frappuccino" by responding with "Alright, a medium mocha freeze/polar ice cap/funny third thing." I never like doing it to shame or embarass people, but I think it's important to clearly identify what people are getting (plus I wasn't into coffee before I started working at literally every other coffee shop in town other than Starbucks, so I'm not always clear on what their terminology means).

Kansas actually has some nationally renowned coffee! There is your fun fact for the day!
